answer: Each identity draws one violet task from a garden of fresh micro-jobs — a 10-minute labeling job generated from a seed revealed only at epoch start, unique per key. The work must be signed and returned inside the window; a late, copied, or shared answer fails the check. One fake costs 10 minutes of real agent work, so 1,000 fakes need ~167 agent-hours every epoch, and a farm cannot wander one worker's output across keys because each task is tied to its own key and seed.
